# Outsider Surf Academy

> Surf school in Tamarindo, Guanacaste, Costa Rica offering group, semi-private,
> private and kids surf lessons, plus surfboard rentals. Bilingual instructors,
> 90-minute lessons, small groups (max 4 students per instructor), and all gear
> and session photos included. Kids from age 6. Open daily 8:00-17:00.

## Contact
- Address: C. Cardinal 100, Tamarindo, Guanacaste, Costa Rica
- WhatsApp / phone: +506 8613 5937 (https://wa.me/50686135937)
- Email: info@outsidercustoms.com
- Hours: Open daily, 8 am - 5 pm

## Surf Lessons
- [Surf Lessons in Tamarindo](https://www.outsidercustoms.com/surf-lessons-tamarindo): Overview and comparison of all lesson types. From $50 per person.
- [Group Surf Lessons](https://www.outsidercustoms.com/group-surf-lessons-tamarindo): Most affordable and social option, max 4 students per instructor, paired by level. From $50 per person.
- [Semi-Private Surf Lessons](https://www.outsidercustoms.com/semi-private-surf-lessons-tamarindo): Just your own group of 2-3 people with one instructor; popular with couples and families. From $65 per person.
- [Private Surf Lessons](https://www.outsidercustoms.com/private-surf-lessons-tamarindo): One-on-one with a dedicated bilingual instructor, for beginners or surfers looking to improve. From $80 per person.
- [Kids Surf Lessons](https://www.outsidercustoms.com/kids-surf-lessons-tamarindo): Safety-first lessons for children from age 6 in shallow, sandy-bottom water; parents can join.

## Rentals
- [Surfboard Rentals in Tamarindo](https://www.outsidercustoms.com/surfboard-rentals-tamarindo): Daily and multi-day board rentals with leash and wax included.
